rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday choice for relieving stress or unwinding.

example.english: I'll relax for a bit first and do it later.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 sung1 haa5 sin1 zan6 gaan1 zoi3 zou6

rows.note: Use this for making something loose, or for something coming loose, such as a rope or cord.

example.english: The rope came loose, so I couldn't relax.
example.traditional: 條繩鬆開咗，我都唔可以放鬆。
example.jyutping: tiu4 sing4 sung1 hoi1 zo2 ngo5 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 fong3 sung1

rows.note: Use this when rules, discipline, requirements, or restrictions are made less strict.

example.english: The company has relaxed its work requirements, so everyone can relax a little.
example.traditional: 公司放寬咗返工要求，大家可以輕鬆啲。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 fong3 fun1 zo2 faan1 gung1 jiu1 kau4 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 hing1 sung1 di1

rows.note: Use this mainly when tensions or a difficult situation become less severe.

example.english: Tensions between labor and management are easing, so employees can finally relax.
example.traditional: 勞資雙方嘅緊張關係逐步緩和，員工終於可以安心啲。
example.jyutping: lou4 zi1 soeng1 fong1 ge3 gan2 zoeng1 gwaan1 hai6 zuk6 bou6 wun6 wo4 jyun4 gung1 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 on1 sam1 di1
